
# Results

This document outlines the performance of the different available algorithms against the
[JSON diff dataset](https://github.com/caohanyang/json_diff_rfc6902/tree/master/dataset)

## Results

Documented below is the performance of the different available algorithms against each dataset


### Xignite

| ![Size of the computed patches for the dataset Xignite](data:image/jpeg;base64,) | ![Time to compute the patches for the dataset Xignite](data:image/jpeg;base64,) |
| --- | --- |
| a) Patch size | b) Diff time |

#### Averages
| Library | Patch Size Avg (bytes) | Diff-time Avg |
| ------- | ---------------------- | ------------------ |
| tiny-patch (minified) | 3756 | 45.703μs |
| tiny-patch | 6705 | 53.744μs |
| JDR | 6705 | 96.637μs |
| Fast-JSON-Patch | 6705 | 20.988μs |
| rfc6902 | 6705 | 5605.45μs |
| jiff | 10167 | 69.703μs |
| JSON8 patch | 15511 | 1.723μs |
